verdict.rationale: Increase provides building blocks for background automation, not a native automation feature. Webhooks let your application act automatically on events (increase-docs-5, increase-docs-24), and real-time decision webhooks let your servers approve or decline card authorizations programmatically (increase-docs-15, increase-docs-20). Some built-in behaviors also run without intervention, such as automatic reconciliation via unique Account Numbers and programmatic sweeps (increase-docs-10, increase-docs-32, increase-docs-33). However, the user must host and run the automation logic on their own servers. Missing for 10: native scheduled or recurring automations, a built-in rules or workflow engine, agent-driven background execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.
